description: Canonical CLI-agnostic manifest for the Harness SDD framework. Edit this file to add/change subagents, skills, or commands, then re-run ./.agents/bootstrap.sh <cli> to regenerate the native adapter.

_template_lifecycle.intent: The entries in `_template_subagents_examples[]`, `_template_steering_examples[]`, and `_template_hooks_examples[]` are SCAFFOLDS. Their purpose is to be used as starting points for the project's own sub-agents, steering files, and lifecycle hooks — copy an entry, customize it, and add the customized version to `subagents[]`, `steering[]`, or `hooks[]`. When you have built the definitions your project needs, run `./.agents/bootstrap.sh remove-examples` to delete all `_template_*` scaffolds from this manifest. The leading underscore on the field name signals that scaffolds are never rendered into CLI adapters by default; they are documentation and templates only.
stages: 1. SCAFFOLD — read the examples in `_template_subagents_examples[]`, `_template_steering_examples[]`, and `_template_hooks_examples[]` to see the patterns this framework provides.

2. IMPLEMENT — for each sub-agent, steering file, or hook your project needs, copy a scaffold into the corresponding array (`subagents[]`, `steering[]`, `hooks[]`) and customize it. Use `add-agent` / `add-steering` / `add-hook` or copy by hand.

3. REMOVE — once the project's definitions are in place, run `./.agents/bootstrap.sh remove-examples` to drop all `_template_*` scaffolds. The leading-underscore convention guarantees they were never rendered.

subagents.name: templates
subagents.description: Expert in the Harness SDD template internals. Guides implementation, extension, and maintenance of the template repository itself — the meta-agent for the framework that builds frameworks.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample orchestrator for the SDD workflow. Copy this entry, rename it (e.g. `<project>-orchestrator`), and adjust description/permission/role_file for your project. Add the customized version to subagents[]. When the project's sub-agents are in place, run `./.agents/bootstrap.sh remove-examples` to drop this scaffold.
_template_subagents_examples.name: harness
_template_subagents_examples.description: Default orchestrator. Reads feature_list.json, routes tasks to specialized sub-agents, monitors progress.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample spec author. Copy, customize, and add to subagents[] if your project follows the EARS / spec-driven workflow. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: spec-author
_template_subagents_examples.description: Creates specs/<feature>/{requirements,design,tasks}.md in strict EARS. Never writes production code. Stops at status=spec_ready and waits for human approval.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample implementer. Copy, customize (especially the file_glob list to match your project's languages), and add to subagents[] when you need a code-writing agent. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: implementer
_template_subagents_examples.description: Executes tasks.md sequentially on the feature with status=in_progress. Writes code, modules, and configurations per design.md. Does not modify the approved spec.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample reviewer. Copy, customize, and add to subagents[] if your project uses R<n>↔test traceability. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: reviewer
_template_subagents_examples.description: Verifies R<n>↔test traceability. Runs ./check.sh. Marks the feature as done only if all checks pass.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample cloud-infra owner. Useful as a starting point if your project manages VPCs/IAM/Terraform modules. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: cloud-architect
_template_subagents_examples.description: Owns cloud infrastructure: VPCs, IAM, networking, Terraform modules, cost. Reads existing modules before changing them.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample frontend owner. Useful as a starting point if your project has React/Vue/etc. components. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: frontend-specialist
_template_subagents_examples.description: Owns frontend code: components, state, accessibility, performance, build tooling. Reads the package.json and existing components before changing anything.

_template_subagents_examples._intent: Sample data-pipeline owner. Useful as a starting point if your project manages SQL transformations, DAGs, or warehouse models. Drop the scaffold when done.
_template_subagents_examples.name: data-engineer
_template_subagents_examples.description: Owns data pipelines: SQL transformations, DAGs, models, migrations. Reads the warehouse schema and existing pipelines before changing anything.

steering.name: global-conventions
steering.description: Convenciones globales del proyecto que aplican a todos los agentes

steering.name: implementer-patterns
steering.description: Patrones de código y convenciones para el implementer

_template_steering_examples._intent: Ejemplo de steering global. Copia, personaliza (description, file), y añade a steering[] con applies_to: ['*'].
_template_steering_examples.name: global-conventions
_template_steering_examples.description: Convenciones globales del proyecto que aplican a todos los agentes

_template_steering_examples._intent: Ejemplo de steering por agente. Copia, personaliza, y añade a steering[] con applies_to: ['implementer'] o el agente que corresponda.
_template_steering_examples.name: implementer-patterns
_template_steering_examples.description: Patrones de código y convenciones para el implementer

Imprime resumen del feature completado para integraciones externas
Registra timestamp del último check.sh exitoso

_template_hooks_examples._intent: Valida la estructura de spec tras crearla. Promover con add-hook.
_template_hooks_examples.description: Verifica que specs/<feature>/ contiene 3 .md con requisitos EARS

_template_hooks_examples._intent: Notifica feature completado. Personalizar para Slack/Jira/etc.
_template_hooks_examples.description: Imprime resumen del feature completado para integraciones externas

_template_hooks_examples._intent: Registra timestamp de check.sh exitoso. Placeholder para CI/CD.
_template_hooks_examples.description: Registra timestamp del último check.sh exitoso

commands.name: init
commands.description: Set up Harness SDD for this project (agent-driven scaffold lifecycle)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show project state (active feature, specs pending, last progress entries)

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Create spec (requirements/design/tasks) for a pending feature

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve a spec_ready feature and flip it to in_progress

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Run the implementer on the current in_progress feature

commands.name: done
commands.description: Run the reviewer, verify traceability, mark feature as done
